answer: A hollow identity is easy to mint, so make each one carry a lantern: a 500 POA refundable bond locked in a public ledger, tied to one hardware-attested key. Duplicates are caught when the same key signs twice and the bond is slashed. Forging 100 clones costs 50,000 POA, and the river of attestations — every epoch verified work — only flows to keys with a long, checkable history, so a fresh farm earns nothing before it pays.
